task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check if the given sequence contain the k or not.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SequenceContainsK(seq: seq<int>, k: int) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - If the method returns true, then the sequence contains at least one occurrence of k
- If the method returns false, then the sequence does not contain k at all
